body.x: NEW YORK, USA (AVING) -- <Visual News> Sim2, a high-end projector manufacturing company of Italy, introduced ''Grand Cinema HT3000'', a full HD DLP projector in Korea market.

It made its first debut this January in Las Vegas during CES 2006 and it offers high resolution of 1,920×1,080 with a built-in 0.95-inch 1,080p DLP chipset. It adapted ''Alpha Path'' optical engine, full 10bit DSP processor, 7-segment color wheel and the company’s exclusive ‘Live color management picture control software’ for enhanced color reproduction. Suggested price is around 20,000,000(KRW).
